description: A Drupal 6 migration source plugin class for localized taxonomy terms, handling translation data for terms including query construction, row preparation, and field definitions.

classes.name: TermLocalizedTranslation
classes.description: A class extending Term to provide a migration source for localized taxonomy terms with translation support.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds a query to retrieve taxonomy term translation data, joining with i18n_strings and locales_target tables.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by setting language and translation fields, skipping duplicates.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines the fields exposed by this source, including language and translation fields.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifiers for the source data, including language.
